sample_unit: open-ended questions (each presented to four model-language configurations)

links.outcome: LLM ABG interpretation score by prompt language (English vs Turkish)
links.effect: English outperformed Turkish in both model families: GPT-4o 22.36 vs 21.28/28; Gemini 1.5 Pro 19.81 vs 17.52/28; hallucination rates 4% vs 7% (GPT-4o) and 18% vs 25% (Gemini).
links.quote: English outperformed Turkish within both model families.

screen.reason: The study is an empirical benchmark comparing the accuracy, hallucination rates, and formula performance of GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro in English vs. Turkish on arterial blood gas interpretation tasks.
